capabilities: Toggle a script layout on the current note via a header button or command
Split Name: Dialogue lines into name and dialogue columns
Leave lines without a colon (stage directions) as normal text
Keep wikilinks, embeds and markdown links working in dialogue
Configure column width, alignment, bold names, and spacing
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README says it was made to improve the readability of scripts written in Markdown files.
problem: Dialogue written as plain "Name: Dialogue" lines in Markdown is hard to read compared with a formatted script layout.
summary: Reading-view layout that renders Name: Dialogue lines as a two-column commercial script format in Markdown notes.
